question: Can one shared-scale, characteristic-response-bounded exposure residual retain a nontrivial P1-forward plus P3D-backing-return signal while removing the exact amplitude and isolated-excursion failures that closed P3L?
epistemic_scope: development only: the exact nine P3L RAW sources informed feasibility and are not a fresh confirmation population

candidate.unbounded_exposure: unchanged P1 forward-only scatter followed by unchanged P3D additive backing return
candidate.source_endpoint: the unmodified RAW-derived relative scene-linear exposure
candidate.response: unchanged U2.2 characteristic curves followed by direct-scan transmittance 10^-density
candidate.shared_scale: minimum exact admissible scale across RGB layers, then applied identically to all three exposure residual channels

severe_vetoes: secondary hard contour or objectionable colour fringe

branch_rule.automatic_fail: close P3N without changing cap, response, projection, parents, gates or population
branch_rule.automatic_pass_visual_fail: retain numerical primitive only and close photographic use
branch_rule.development_pass: retain as a generic physical-inspired development challenger; require a separately frozen fresh population before any runtime or product value test

forbidden_actions: change P1, P3D, U2.2 or the closed P3L result
select cap or gates after the formal run
fit or infer a stock, process, scanner or anti-halation profile
call the bounded residual calibrated physical truth
promote from this seen development population
use a visual pass to override any automatic failure
claim_ceiling: generic physical-inspired development evidence for one response-bounded exposure residual; no measured film, stock, process, scanner, calibration, preference, authenticity or product claim
